name: The Misfits
caption: Won the MECW Tag Team Championship on the broadcast where Johnny Eastland took the Hardcore title; the promotion's own report names neither its members nor its opponents.

tenures.note: Winning the Tag Team Championship is reported without naming opponents or members.

identity.note: Shares the name The Misfits with units already recorded on two other wings (a duo at gdwa and a trio at uwf-mar96, which also happens to carry an unrelated Corey Irons record). No shared operator, roster or chronology evidence links this MECW unit to either; recorded distinct under the standing no-merge default for a recurring name.
